description: This file provides JSON utility functions for encoding, decoding, and number conversion, specifically tailored for Kubernetes. It includes functions for marshaling, unmarshaling with case sensitivity, and converting json.Number types to int64 or float64, with recursive traversal to handle nested structures.

methods.name: NewEncoder
methods.description: Creates a new JSON encoder that delegates to encoding/json's NewEncoder.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a Go value into JSON, delegating to encoding/json's Marshal.

methods.name: Unmarshal
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a Go value, using a case-sensitive unmarshal that preserves integers.

methods.name: ConvertInterfaceNumbers
methods.description: Recursively converts json.Number values within an interface{} to int64 or float64.

methods.name: ConvertMapNumbers
methods.description: Recursively traverses a map to convert json.Number values to int64 or float64.

methods.name: ConvertSliceNumbers
methods.description: Recursively traverses a slice to convert json.Number values to int64 or float64.

methods.name: convertNumber
methods.description: Converts a json.Number to an int64 if possible, otherwise to a float64.
